name: working-from-lenny
description: Eleven PM tools drawn from the Lenny's Newsletter and How I AI corpora. Each tool ships with corpus-anchored content; the host's LLM handles narration via sampling.
long_description: Eleven small tools (quiz-and-narration apps, paste-and-critique apps, wizard apps, and rehearsal apps) built on a current-consensus knowledge base over Lenny Rachitsky's newsletter and podcast plus Claire Vo's How I AI show. Narration runs through the host's LLM via MCP sampling; if sampling is unavailable, the user can configure an API key in user_config. State for the few stateful tools lives in the bundle's local data dir; no remote storage.

tools.name: pm_pitfalls_score
tools.description: Deterministic. Returns the user's score (0-20) and the three highest-leverage pitfall IDs given their twenty answers.

tools.name: pm_pitfalls_narrate
tools.description: LLM-narrated. Takes the score and top three picks and returns personalized one-paragraph diagnoses + behavior suggestions per pitfall.

tools.name: pm_pitfalls_drift
tools.description: Stateful. Returns the user's calibration drift across re-audits. Persists answers locally between runs.

api_key.title: Inference API key (fallback)
api_key.description: Only needed if the host doesn't implement MCP sampling. Get one from console.anthropic.com, ai.google.dev/gemini-api, or platform.openai.com. Optional otherwise.

api_provider.title: API provider
api_provider.description: Which provider the api_key is for, used only when sampling is unavailable. One of: anthropic, gemini, openai.
